title: Arrangement Terms — The Payment a Plan Bills While an Arrangement Runs, Belrose Promotional Financing Plans
content:
# Arrangement Terms — The Payment a Plan Bills While an Arrangement Runs, Belrose Promotional Financing Plans

The reduced payment a Belrose Promotional Financing Plan bills while an arrangement runs is the hardship share applied to the payment the arrangement is built on, increased by the interest the arrangement carries and by the arrangement charge the desk makes, and reduced by the relief the desk allows for the customer's other commitments with the chain.

**The payment the arrangement is built on** is the scheduled monthly payment the plan record carries.

**The months the arrangement runs for** are the term's hardship length, as the hardship training note states it for the plan's promotional term.

**The hardship share** is the term's hardship share.

**The interest.** The arrangement carries no interest.

**The arrangement charge.** The arrangement charge the desk makes is this desk's standard arrangement charge of **7.50 USD**.

**The relief.** No relief is allowed for other commitments.

**The order of the arithmetic.** The hardship share is applied to the payment the arrangement is built on and that figure is rounded to the cent; the interest and the arrangement charge are then added to it and the relief is taken off; the result is rounded to the cent at the end only, and where the rounded figure falls below nothing the payment stands at nothing.

## Worked figure (hypothetical inputs)

A plan record carries a scheduled monthly payment of 265.00 USD, on a promotional term whose hardship share is 60 percent.

- *The hardship share applied to the payment the arrangement is built on*: 60 percent of 265.00 USD is 159.00 USD, rounded to the cent at that point.
- *The interest*: nothing. *The arrangement charge*: 7.50 USD. *The relief*: nothing.
- *The reduced payment*: 159.00 USD together with nothing and 7.50 USD, less nothing, is 166.50 USD; rounded to the cent at the end the plan bills **166.50 USD** each cycle while the arrangement runs.

The share is rounded to the cent where it is applied, and the whole figure is rounded again only at the end, so the two roundings are never collapsed into one at the finish.
